draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.40, the 20th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 1st of 25 at LB. He lasted until pick 83, well after his grade rank (20th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Devin Bush. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 72 tackles in 2021, 18th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Las Vegas Raiders. 47 career games and 27 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: sacks 4.0 (96th percentile), tackles for loss 7 (89th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 off-ball linebacker who played: 55 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
